tasks.title: Implement native resource action eligibility and exact operator grant enforcement
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver finite source/binding/task administrative action eligibility using actual stored targets and current native ICapabilityAuthorizer. Publication/release/assignment/manual/cancel needs its original-result recovery grant bundle; direct mutations and recovery independently reauthorize after preview or grant changes. Preserve independently validated human versus workload identity, existing strict Entra semantics, and no broadly privileged portal fallback/copied-claim/inventory authority. Hidden resources, counts/details/cursors are not disclosed, and optional backends report unsupported honestly. This owns the native action and grant slice of RM09-AC03, RM09-AC04, RM09-AC07, RM09-AC10, RM09-AC11, RM09-AC12, RM09-AC15, RM09-AC16 and RM10-AC02, RM10-AC08, RM10-AC14, RM10-AC21, RM10-AC24, RM10-AC29, RM10-AC30.
tasks.validation: Reuse existing native Management auth/HTTPS fixture with exact source/binding/task grants, write-without-lookup and revoked lookup; test direct hidden-target/action/cursor abuse and old-backend unsupported behavior. Document grant bundles and include proportionate independent review. Actual scheduler callback/lease proof stays with runtime/integration owners. This initial unstarted split still has generated inherited dependencies; the controller must refine its concrete prerequisite/ownership validation through the supported child update before activating implementation.

tasks.title: Implement bounded trusted cohort discovery and rollout grant choices
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver bounded authorized cohort choices for each exact Configuration binding using trusted configured mappings, frozen admitted registration cohort and retained assignment pins consistently with actual map admission. Return meaningful safe identifiers/labels, never issuer/subject membership or a way to invent a cohort from arbitrary text. Reauthorize current binding/read/recovery/action grants and preserve exact scoped cursor authority. Add narrow typed optional backend/client discovery without a generic permissions engine or alternate Configuration authority. This owns cohort/discovery portions of RM09-AC04, RM09-AC07, RM09-AC11, RM09-AC13, RM09-AC15, RM09-AC16, RM09-AC19 and RM10-AC28, RM10-AC29.
tasks.validation: Prove configured/frozen/pinned cohort consistency, unauthorized source/binding/page/cursor refusal and no membership leakage with existing native fixtures; test finite pages/unknown backends and both SDKs. Document cohort/grant ownership and review this small implementation independently. This initial unstarted split still has generated inherited dependencies; the controller must refine its concrete prerequisite/ownership validation through the supported child update before activating implementation.
